stories.story_fr: Ecolab a affiché une croissance à deux chiffres du BPA dilué.
stories.story_en: Ecolab delivered double-digit diluted EPS growth.
stories.quote: delivered another strong quarter of double-digit EPS growth

stories.story_fr: La tarification de valeur et les améliorations de productivité ont soutenu la performance.
stories.story_en: Value pricing and productivity improvements drove performance.
stories.quote: value pricing, volume growth, and productivity improvements

stories.story_fr: Les ventes organiques ont progressé de 3% malgré les impacts négatifs.
stories.story_en: Organic sales grew 3% despite unfavorable impacts.
stories.quote: Organic sales +3%, led by continued strong growth

stories.story_fr: Ecolab prévoit un BPA dilué ajusté de 7,42 à 7,62 dollars en 2025.
stories.story_en: Ecolab expects adjusted diluted EPS of $7.42 to $7.62 in 2025.
